name: ke.co.swiftpesa/african-money
title: SwiftPesa African Money Data
description: Take-home pay, mobile money fees, central bank rates and car CRSP for 12 African countries.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Use first if you're unsure whether a country is covered: lists every country with data, its currency, which kinds of calculator it has (income tax/PAYE, mobile money, bank fees, loans, savings, SACCO dividends) and which central bank indicators exist. Takes no inputs.

tools.name: get_take_home_pay
tools.description: Use for any salary question: net (take-home) pay after income tax (PAYE) and payroll deductions (pension, social security, health, housing levies) for a gross salary in one African country. Picks the country's main PAYE calculator for you, so you only need the country and the amount. Returns tax, each deduction, net pay, effective and marginal rates, monthly and yearly figures, and a one-sentence summary. For the underlying tax bands use get_calculator_rules; for other calculators (loans, savings) use run_calculator.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Kenya", "ke", "South Africa", "ng".

period.description: Whether gross is monthly or yearly. Defaults to the country's PAYE period (yearly for Nigeria, South Africa; monthly elsewhere).

tools.name: get_mobile_money_fees
tools.description: Use for "how much does it cost to send/withdraw/pay" questions: mobile money charges (M-Pesa, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, EcoCash, Orange Money, Mixx by Yas and others) for one amount in one country. Returns every transaction type's fee for that amount and a one-sentence summary. For bank transfers (PesaLink) use run_calculator with pesalink-charges-calculator.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Kenya", "ke", "South Africa", "ng".

amount.description: Amount sent or withdrawn, in local currency.

tools.name: get_country_overview
tools.description: Use when the user asks about a country in general or you need context before answering: one call returns the country's central bank rate and inflation, how PAYE works (bands, deductions, a worked example at a typical salary), mobile money fees at a typical amount, and its other calculators. For a specific salary or amount, use get_take_home_pay or get_mobile_money_fees instead; to compare rates across several countries, use get_central_bank_rates.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Kenya", "ke", "South Africa", "ng".

tools.name: get_central_bank_rates
tools.description: Use for interest rate and inflation questions, especially comparing countries: latest central bank policy rates, inflation and Treasury bill yields, for one country or all of them, each with its date, official source, the previous reading and the direction of change. Optionally the full history. For one country's whole picture (rates plus pay and fees), use get_country_overview.

country.description: Country name or code. Leave out for all countries.

indicator.description: policy-rate, inflation, tbill-91 or tbill-364. Leave out for all.

tools.name: list_calculators
tools.description: Use to find a calculator's slug before get_calculator_rules or run_calculator: lists calculators with open rules (PAYE, mobile money tariffs, bank fees, loans, savings, SACCO dividends), optionally filtered by country and type. To see which countries are covered at all, use list_countries.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Kenya", "ke", "South Africa", "ng".

tools.name: get_calculator_rules
tools.description: Use when the user wants the rules themselves rather than a calculation: the tax bands, deductions, reliefs, fee tables, or loan and savings parameters behind one calculator, with official sources, caveats, the inputs it takes and when it was last verified. Rates are decimals (0.3 = 30%) unless the field says pct.

slug.description: Calculator slug from list_calculators, e.g. kenya-paye-calculator.

tools.name: run_calculator
tools.description: Use for calculations that have no dedicated tool: loan repayments {principal, rate, months}, savings and money market growth {principal, monthly, years, rate}, PesaLink bank fees {amount, bank}, SACCO dividends {shares, deposits}, or a specific calculator such as Kenya's NSSF-only calculator. Needs a slug from list_calculators; get_calculator_rules lists each calculator's inputs. For salaries prefer get_take_home_pay, and for mobile money prefer get_mobile_money_fees. Returns the breakdown and a one-sentence summary.

tools.name: search_kenya_car_crsp
tools.description: Use for Kenyan car import and valuation questions: looks up KRA's Current Retail Selling Price (CRSP), the value Kenya's import duty is calculated from, by make and/or model, e.g. "toyota vitz", "prado", "nissan note". Kenya only: other countries have no CRSP data here.
